Name: Spouse Income SVE
Author: Astraios
TagLine: This mod makes your spouse give you a portion of their income every few days.
Description:
Ever wished your spouse chipped in a bit more? This mod lets your significant other show some love with a little financial help! Look forward to finding sweet notes and some extra cash in your mailbox every few days. Check out the vanilla version made by rifkyap12. Also please endorse if you like the mod ❤️

Features

Spouses with jobs now contribute a portion of their income to your shared fund.
Receive heartwarming notes alongside the financial boost - who doesn't love that?
Adds a touch of realism and makes checking your mail more rewarding.
Installation


To enjoy this mod, you'll need a few things:

SMAPI (https://smapi.io/) - This is a core modding API for Stardew Valley.
Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) - This mod allows you to add new content to the game.
Mailbox Framework Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536) - This mod is required for this specific mod to function.


Just download and install these according to their instructions, then place this mod's file in your Stardew Valley mods folder.

Credits

rifkyap12 - For giving me permission to make a SVE version of their mod.
Kari﻿ - For "encouraging" me to make this mod better.
